node.statement: Inverse cancellation in the correctly typed space: tilde-Phi(x) lies in A=Im(tilde-Phi), and u=v^(-1) from lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation entails v o u=I_A; hence iota_{A subseteq B(H)}(v(u(tilde-Phi(x))))=iota_{A subseteq B(H)}(tilde-Phi(x))=tilde-Phi(x).
